title: More People Now Choose Cremation Over Burial
hook: More people now choose fire over the ground.
closing: Keep that pace and burial could be the rare choice within a generation.
question: Would you choose cremation or burial?

segments.say: In the 1970s, almost nobody in America chose cremation. Today it's 63 percent and still climbing.
Cremation now sits at 63.4 percent, more than double burial's share.
Nevada cremates over 80 percent of people, far more than many other states.
